title: Highly recommend it!!!
text: Exploring Paris on a guided tour was an absolute delight! Our tour guide was not only knowledgeable about the city's history and landmarks but also passionate about sharing their insights. From strolling along the Seine River to marveling at the grandeur of the tower Eiffel, every moment was filled with wonder and discovery. The tour struck the perfect balance between iconic attractions and hidden gems, giving us a comprehensive glimpse into the heart of Paris. Highly recommend this tour for anyone looking to experience the magic of the city with an expert guide!
author: Artist12345678

title: Great food tour experience with a local!
text:
We booked in March this tour with two of my friends to discover secrets of the city of light and taste parisian cookery with a real parisian lady. what a good half day we had with Line our tour guide: she is so kind  and funny . We learnt interesting  stories of the neighborhood   and were  brought to some typical addresses to  savor tasty finger food (even vegan option is available). I recommend definitely, it is worth it :)

Julien
author: calyon02

title: Best experience ever!!!! Highly recommended it!!!!
